This '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. These [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]]s were distinguished by their [[Color/Legends|dark green]] skin and tiered noses. One member of this species, [[Abron Mar]], served as a lieutenant in [[Takara]]'s criminal organization<ref name="Sith" /> by [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].<ref name="TNEC">According to the opening scrawl, ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' takes place five [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]] after the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''Jedi Knight'' to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Using simple math, we can deduce that ''Mysteries of the Sith'' takes place in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].</ref>

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared<ref name="Jedi">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''</ref> in the [[1997]]<ref name="MC">{{WebCite|url=https://www.metacritic.com/game/pc/star-wars-jedi-knight-dark-forces-ii|text=Star Wars Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II for PC Reviews|archivedate=20200409213403}}</ref><ref name="GR">{{WebCite|url=https://www.gamerankings.com/pc/24354-star-wars-jedi-knight-dark-forces-ii/index.html|text=Star Wars Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II for PC|archivedate=20191209015004}}</ref> video game ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'',<ref name="Jedi" /> added into the game in the ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' expansion pack<ref name="Sith" /> which debuted the year after the base game's release.<ref name="ExpDate">{{LucasArts|url=pages/TopIndexFamily.main.html|text=LucasArts Company Store}}</ref>
